_comment: The one frozen instant every scenario in this corpus is captured at. Mid-month so days_remaining, the trailing-7-day burn window and the previous-month window are all non-degenerate. Matches the _today() anchor already used by backend/tests/integration/test_query_service.py. Both the server clock (query_service._utc, report_service._utc) and the browser clock (vi.setSystemTime, page.clock.install) are pinned here — see README.md.
